conceptZh: 布忍者想偷偷幫小妹妹疊積木，不小心碰倒一整排軟積木，倒成「姐」，小的玩偶開心抱住大的。
object: a tiny felt ninja, a smaller plush sibling with ponytails, and a row of soft coral felt blocks
morph: a row of soft coral felt blocks tumbles into the glyph 姐 beside two toy siblings
creativeAngle: 骨牌效應：布忍者躲在花盆後偷偷推一下軟積木，結果倒成「姐」；「姐姐」用小玩偶抱住大玩偶呼應。
promptEn: An 8-second soft-and-silly felt-toy clip on a clean solid pale lilac backdrop, with one large Traditional Chinese glyph 姐 as the only text, composed of thick matte-looking but strongly saturated coral-red felt strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered with margins. Lead: a tiny felt ninja with a black mask and purple headband who is spectacularly bad at hiding and convinced nobody can see him; one supporting character, a smaller plush toy with two little ponytails. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 姐、姐、姐姐 (ㄐㄧㄝˇ、ㄐㄧㄝˇ、ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄐㄧㄝ˙); the second syllable of the word takes the neutral tone; slow with clear tones, then silence. Moment 1 (0–1.7s): the ninja crouches behind a tiny flowerpot that hides only his belly, peeks out with one eye, and as the first 姐 is spoken sneaks out a pinky to tip the first soft coral block, which wobbles and falls into the next. Moment 2 (1.7–3.4s): the blocks fall in a flopping chain across the frame, the ninja dives in a panicked tiptoe to catch them, tangles his scarf around two blocks and is dragged along sideways on his belly, headband flapping. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): the chain curls and lands as the second 姐 is spoken, forming 姐: on the left a woman-shaped part with a diagonal swoop, a crossing stroke and a horizontal bar; on the right a small box on a vertical stack with two horizontal bars, like a stack of three layers. The ninja, upside down at the end of the glyph, tips his head and gives a shy bow. Moment 4 (5s): as 姐姐 is spoken, the smaller plush with ponytails runs over, hugs the ninja's leg, then tugs him over to another larger soft felt toy with a ponytail bow, which scoops her into a tight hug, both rocking left and right. Final 5–8s: the glyph 姐 stays completely still and sharp while the two plush siblings rock gently in a hug and the ninja sits behind a flowerpot giving a thumbs up, never touching the strokes. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.

conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長為了按一顆小小的門鈴，用盡全力衝刺，結果直接衝過門鈴撞進一疊珊瑚紅長條，長條被撞飛後正好落成「姐」；警長冒煙倒滑回來，輕輕一點門鈴「叮」，最後一條落定，高高的姐姐狗走來幫他扶正帽子。
object: a tiny doorbell button on a short post at bottom-left, and a neat stack of thick coral-red foam bars at center that the sheriff crashes into
morph: the crash launches the bars into the air and they land as the strokes of 姐: the curved stroke, long sweeping diagonal and horizontal bar of 女 on the left, and the tall box with two inner bars on a wide base of 且 on the right; the last base bar drops into place only when the sheriff finally taps the bell gently
creativeAngle: 沿用「用力過猛」模式：小任務是按一顆門鈴，警長卻全力衝刺、衝過頭、撞進長條堆，撞擊本身把筆畫撞到定位，最後輕輕一點才完成最後一筆，因果清楚、六歲一看就懂。捨棄前一版安靜的綁緞帶與布忍者推積木，改成大動作撞擊與回滑冒煙。豬探長不需要出場，唯一配角改為高一個頭的姐姐狗，讓「姐姐」這個詞一說出口畫面就有對應的「比較高、會照顧人的姐姐」，聲音與畫面同一個故事。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright cartoon slapstick clip on a clean solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, where the only text is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 姐, built from thick saturated coral-red foam bars, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Lead: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog, golden fur, star badge, tiny whistle on a cord, who believes every job needs maximum power. Props: a tiny round doorbell button on a short post at bottom-left foreground, and behind it at center a tidy stack of coral-red foam bars. One supporting character arrives at the end: his big sister, a taller Labrador with a red bow on one ear and a slightly bigger badge. No real people, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no background music.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 姐、姐、姐姐 (ㄐㄧㄝˇ、ㄐㄧㄝˇ、ㄐㄧㄝˇ ˙ㄐㄧㄝ), reading exactly those syllables slowly and distinctly with clear tones, the second syllable of the word light and neutral, then silence. Only a soft bell "ding" and gentle cartoon bonk sounds otherwise.

0–1.5s, want it: the sheriff trots in from the left, spots the tiny doorbell, points at it with his whole paw and nods, deadly serious. He backs up to the left edge, digs in his hind paws, and winds up like a sprinter, tail spinning like a propeller, a tiny puff of dust behind him. The first 姐 is spoken as he crouches into the wind-up.

1.5–3s, try and miss: he rockets across the frame left to right, hat lifting off his head, and whooshes straight past the doorbell by a whisker without touching it. BONK, he plows into the stack of foam bars at center with a big squash-and-stretch, his face flattening comically, and all the bars spring up into the air in a slow fountain.

3–4.5s, the crash settles: the bars tumble down and land in place at center, forming 姐 as the second 姐 is spoken: on the left, a curved stroke crossing a long sweeping diagonal with a horizontal bar through them, the 女 part; on the right, a tall upright box with two horizontal bars stacked inside it, the 且 part, missing only its wide base bar, which is still spinning in the air above. Meanwhile the sheriff skids backward in reverse with little smoke puffs from his paws, stars circling his head, and stops exactly in front of the doorbell with a dizzy grin.

4.5–5.5s, the payoff: he lifts one claw, taps the doorbell gently, "ding", and the last spinning bar drops neatly into place as the wide base under the right side, completing 姐. The glyph is finished and sharp. As 姐姐 is spoken, his big sister walks in from the left edge, a head taller, bow on her ear, and plants a hand on her hip looking at the mess, then pats him on the head and straightens his crooked hat.

5–8s, final hold: the glyph 姐 stays perfectly still and readable at center. In the bottom-left corner, away from the strokes, the big sister dusts off his badge, he gives a wobbly proud salute, loses balance for one beat, and she steadies him with one paw, both smiling. Nobody touches or covers the strokes. Bright even daylight, saturated coral-red strokes against the pale backdrop, no flashing effects, no watermark, no other text.
